en: Sura 36: Ya-Sin
ja: 第36章 ヤー・スィーン章

p.src: 36:1  Yā Sīn[1]

en: Yā Sīn[1]
ja: ヤー・スィーン[1]。
u.src: 36:1  Yā Sīn[1]

en: [1] See footnote 2:1.
ja: [1]　この文字群については、頻出名・用語解説の「クルアーン*の冒頭に現れる文字群*」を参照。

p.src: 36:2  By the Qur’an, full of wisdom,

en: By the Qur’an, full of wisdom,
ja: 完全無欠な[1]クルアーン*に誓って、
u.src: 36:2  By the Qur’an, full of wisdom,

ja: [1]　「完全無欠な」については、ユーヌス*章1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 36:3  You [O Muhammad] are indeed one of the messengers,

en: You [O Muhammad] are indeed one of the messengers,
ja: 本当に（ムハンマド*よ、）あなたはまさしく、使徒*の一人、
u.src: 36:3  You [O Muhammad] are indeed one of the messengers,

p.src: 36:4  on a straight path,

en: on a straight path,
ja: まっすぐな道（イスラーム*）の上にある。
u.src: 36:4  on a straight path,

p.src: 36:5  [This is] a revelation from the All-Mighty, Most Merciful,

en: [This is] a revelation from the All-Mighty, Most Merciful,
ja: （アッラー*は、クルアーン*を）偉力ならびなく*、慈悲あまねき*お方の下されたものとして（お下しになった）。
u.src: 36:5  [This is] a revelation from the All-Mighty, Most Merciful,

p.src: 36:6  so that you warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

en: so that you warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
ja: （それは使徒*よ、あなたの到来以前に）自分たちの先祖が警告されておらず、（信仰と正しい行い*において）無頓着になっている民[1]に、あなたが警告するため。
u.src: 36:6  so that you warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

ja: [1]　この「民」は、アラブ人のこと（ムヤッサル４４０頁参照）。尚このアーヤ*が、アラブ人以外の者に対しての警告を否定することにはならない。家畜章1９、高壁章1５８とその訳注、識別章1、サバア章2８なども参照（イブン・カスィール６：1６６参照）。

p.src: 36:7  The decree [of punishment] has been passed against most of them, for they will not believe.

en: The decree [of punishment] has been passed against most of them, for they will not believe.
ja: （真理を知った後に拒否した）彼らの多くには、既に、（懲罰という）御言葉が確定した。彼らは、信仰しないのだから。
u.src: 36:7  The decree [of punishment] has been passed against most of them, for they will not believe.

p.src: 36:8  [It is as if] We have placed shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced to remain up,

en: [It is as if] We have placed shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced to remain up,
ja: 本当にわれら*は、彼らの首に枷をつけた。それは彼らのあごに至っており、彼ら（の顔）は上を仰がされた状態にある。[1]
u.src: 36:8  [It is as if] We have placed shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced to remain up,

ja: [1]　両手をあごの下につけた形で、首もろとも枷をつけられているので、頭が上方を向いた状態（イブン・カスィール６：1６６参照）。この解釈には、「導かれない状態のたとえ」「アッラー*の道において施（ほどこ）さないことのたとえ（夜の旅章2９参照）」「あらゆる善から阻（はば）まれている状態」「地獄の懲罰の光景（赦し深いお方章７1参照）」など、諸説ある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：８－９参照）。

p.src: 36:9  and We have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have blocked their vision so they cannot see[2].

en: and We have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have blocked their vision so they cannot see[2].
ja: そしてわれら*は（その不信仰と傲慢さゆえに）、彼らの前に障壁を置き、その後ろからも障壁を置き[1]、彼ら（の眼）を覆った[2]。それで彼らは（正道を）見ることがない。
u.src: 36:9  and We have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have blocked their vision so they cannot see[2].

en: [2] Because of their obstinacy and persistence in disbelief.
ja: [1]　これは、信仰から阻まれている様子のこと（ムヤッサル４４０頁参照）。 [2]　雌牛章７、フード*章2０とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 36:10  It is the same to them whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.

en: It is the same to them whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.
ja: （使徒*よ、）あなたが彼らに警告したとしても、警告しなかったとしても、彼らにとっては同じこと。彼らは信じはしないのだ。
u.src: 36:10  It is the same to them whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.

p.src: 36:11  You can only warn one who follows the Reminder[3] and fears the Most Compassionate unseen. So give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.

en: You can only warn one who follows the Reminder[3] and fears the Most Compassionate unseen. So give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.
ja: 本当にあなたは教訓（クルアーン*）に従い、まだ見ぬままに慈悲あまねき*お方（アッラー*）を恐れる[1]者にこそ、（有効な）警告をするのである。ならばその者には（罪の）赦しと、貴い褒美[2]の吉報を伝えよ。
u.src: 36:11  You can only warn one who follows the Reminder[3] and fears the Most Compassionate unseen. So give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.

en: [3] i.e., the Qur’an.
ja: [1]　「まだ見ぬままにアッラー*を恐れること」については、預言者*たち章４９の訳注を参照。 [2]　天国のこととされる（ムヤッサル４４０頁参照）。

p.src: 36:12  It is We Who give life to the dead, and record what they send forth and what they leave behind, and We keep an account of everything in a clear Record[4].

en: It is We Who give life to the dead, and record what they send forth and what they leave behind, and We keep an account of everything in a clear Record[4].
ja: 本当にわれら*は（復活の日*、）死者たちに生を与えるのであり、彼らが（現世で）行っていたことと、その軌跡[1]を書き留める。そしてわれら*は全ての物事を、明らかなる規範[2]の中で数え尽くしておいたのである。
u.src: 36:12  It is We Who give life to the dead, and record what they send forth and what they leave behind, and We keep an account of everything in a clear Record[4].

en: [4] See footnote 35:11.
ja: [1]　「その軌跡」とは、彼らの生前と死後に、彼らが原因として生じた善いことや悪いこと。前者の例としては、シルク*や諸々の罪などがある（前掲書、同頁参照）。 [2]　「明らかなる規範」とは、守られし碑板*。存在する全てのものは元々、この中に記録されている、ということ（イブン・カスィール６：５６８参照）。高壁章８の訳注も参照。

p.src: 36:13  Give them an example of the People of the Town when the messengers came to it.

en: Give them an example of the People of the Town when the messengers came to it.
ja: （使徒*よ、）彼ら（シルク*の徒）に、一つの譬えを挙げよ。町の人々（の話）を。使徒たちが、そこへとやって来た時のこと。
u.src: 36:13  Give them an example of the People of the Town when the messengers came to it.

p.src: 36:14  When We sent them two [messengers], but they rejected them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, “We are sent to you as messengers.”

en: When We sent them two [messengers], but they rejected them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, “We are sent to you as messengers.”
ja: われら*が彼らに（アッラー*への信仰と、シルク*の放棄へと招く）二人（の使徒）を遣わし、彼らが二人を噓つき呼ばわりした時のこと。それでわれら*は（その二人を）三人目（の使徒）で強化した。すると、彼ら（使徒たち）は言った。「本当に私たちは、あなた方へと遣わされたものなのです」。
u.src: 36:14  When We sent them two [messengers], but they rejected them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, “We are sent to you as messengers.”

p.src: 36:15  They said, “You are no more than human beings like us, and the Most Compassionate has not sent down anything. You are simply lying.”

en: They said, “You are no more than human beings like us, and the Most Compassionate has not sent down anything. You are simply lying.”
ja: 彼ら（町の人々）は言った。「あなた方は、私たちと同様の人間に過ぎない。そして慈悲あまねき*お方（アッラー*）は、（啓示など）何一つ下してはいないのだ。あなた方は嘘をついているに過ぎない」。
u.src: 36:15  They said, “You are no more than human beings like us, and the Most Compassionate has not sent down anything. You are simply lying.”

p.src: 36:16  They said, “Our Lord knows that we are sent to you as messengers.

en: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are sent to you as messengers.
ja: 彼ら（使徒たち）は言った。「我らが主*は、本当に私たちがまさしく、あなた方に対する使徒であることをご存知である。
u.src: 36:16  They said, “Our Lord knows that we are sent to you as messengers.

p.src: 36:17  Our duty is only to convey the message clearly.”

en: Our duty is only to convey the message clearly.”
ja: そして私たちの義務は、（啓示の）明白なる伝達に外ならない」。
u.src: 36:17  Our duty is only to convey the message clearly.”

p.src: 36:18  The people said, “We consider you as an evil omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and we will inflict upon you a painful punishment.”

en: The people said, “We consider you as an evil omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and we will inflict upon you a painful punishment.”
ja: 彼ら（町の人々）は言った。「本当に私たちは、あなた方を不吉に思う[1]。もしも、あなた方が（私たちをあなた方の教えに招くのを）止めなければ、私たちは必ずや、あなた方を（石で）打ち殺してやろう[2]。そして、きっと私たちからの痛ましい懲罰が、あなた方に降りかかるであろう」。
u.src: 36:18  The people said, “We consider you as an evil omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and we will inflict upon you a painful punishment.”

ja: [1]　「不吉に思う」については、高壁章1３1の訳注を参照。 [2]　「（石で）打ち殺す」については、フード*章９1の同表現の訳注を参照。

p.src: 36:19  The messengers said, “Your evil omen is with yourselves [because of your disbelief]. Is it[5] because you are admonished? Rather, you are a people who transgress all bounds.”

en: The messengers said, “Your evil omen is with yourselves [because of your disbelief]. Is it[5] because you are admonished? Rather, you are a people who transgress all bounds.”
ja: 彼ら（使徒たち）は言った。「あなた方の不吉のもとは、あなた方のところにある[1]。たとえ教訓を与えられたとしても、（あなた方は私たちを不吉がり、私たちを脅すの）か？いや、あなた方は（罪と嘘呼ばわりにおいて）度を越した民である」。
u.src: 36:19  The messengers said, “Your evil omen is with yourselves [because of your disbelief]. Is it[5] because you are admonished? Rather, you are a people who transgress all bounds.”

en: [5] i.e., this threat.
ja: [1]　不吉なことが起こるのは、彼らの不信仰のせいだ、ということ。あるいは、善いことも悪いことも、全て既に定命なのである、ということ（アル＝バガウィー４：11参照）。

p.src: 36:20  A man came from the farthest end of the city, rushing, and said, “O my people, follow the messengers.

en: A man came from the farthest end of the city, rushing, and said, “O my people, follow the messengers.
ja: そして（彼らが使徒たちを手にかけようとした時）、町の一番遠くから、一人の男が急いでやって来た。彼は言った。「我が民よ、使徒たちに従うのだ。
u.src: 36:20  A man came from the farthest end of the city, rushing, and said, “O my people, follow the messengers.

p.src: 36:21  Follow those who ask no recompense of you, and who are guided.

en: Follow those who ask no recompense of you, and who are guided.
ja: あなた方に見返り[1]を求めない者に、従え。彼らは導かれた者たちなのだ。
u.src: 36:21  Follow those who ask no recompense of you, and who are guided.

ja: [1]　この「見返り」については、家畜章９０の訳注を参照。

p.src: 36:22  Why should I not worship the One Who created me and to Whom you will all be brought back?

en: Why should I not worship the One Who created me and to Whom you will all be brought back?
ja: それに私が、自分のことを創成して下さった*お方を崇めない、などということがあろうか？かれの御許にこそ、あなた方は戻らされるというのに？
u.src: 36:22  Why should I not worship the One Who created me and to Whom you will all be brought back?

p.src: 36:23  Should I take besides Him other gods whose intercession cannot avail me in the least, nor can they come to my rescue, if the Most Compassionate wills to harm me?

en: Should I take besides Him other gods whose intercession cannot avail me in the least, nor can they come to my rescue, if the Most Compassionate wills to harm me?
ja: 一体私が、かれを差しおいて（外の）神々[1]を選ぶというのか？もし慈悲あまねき*お方（アッラー*）が私に害悪をお望みになれば、彼らの執り成しは私を何一つ益することもなく、彼らは私を救ってもくれないのに。
u.src: 36:23  Should I take besides Him other gods whose intercession cannot avail me in the least, nor can they come to my rescue, if the Most Compassionate wills to harm me?

ja: [1]　「神々」に関しては、雌牛章1３３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 36:24  Surely I would then be clearly misguided.

en: Surely I would then be clearly misguided.
ja: そんなことをすれば、本当に私はまさしく紛れもない迷いの中にある。
u.src: 36:24  Surely I would then be clearly misguided.

p.src: 36:25  I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”

en: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”
ja: 本当に私は、あなた方の主*を信じた。だから、私に耳を傾けるのだ」。
u.src: 36:25  I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”

p.src: 36:26  [But they killed him], so he was told[6], “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew[7]

en: [But they killed him], so he was told[6], “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew[7]
ja: （彼はこうして殉教した後、こう）言われた。「天国に入るがよい」。彼は言った。「我が民が、知っていたらよかったのに。
u.src: 36:26  [But they killed him], so he was told[6], “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew[7]

en: [6] After he was martyred for the sake of Allah. [7] He said so after Allah admitted him into paradise and he saw the pleasures therein.

p.src: 36:27  of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me among the honored ones.”

en: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me among the honored ones.”
ja: （私の信仰と忍耐*、使徒*たちへの追従ゆえに）我が主*が私をお赦しになり、私を栄誉高き者たちの一人として下さったことを」。
u.src: 36:27  of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me among the honored ones.”

p.src: 36:28  After his death, We did not send down any soldiers from heaven against his people, nor would We have done so.

en: After his death, We did not send down any soldiers from heaven against his people, nor would We have done so.
ja: われら*はその（男の死と、使徒たちを噓つき呼ばわりした）後、その民に対し、天から（天使*の）軍勢など下すまでもなかった。われら*は（人々を滅ぼすため、わざわざ天使*を）下す者ではなかったのである。
u.src: 36:28  After his death, We did not send down any soldiers from heaven against his people, nor would We have done so.

p.src: 36:29  It was no more than a single blast, and immediately they were extinguished.

en: It was no more than a single blast, and immediately they were extinguished.
ja: それは、（轟く）一声に過ぎなかった。そしてどうであろう、彼らは息絶えた者となってしまったのである。
u.src: 36:29  It was no more than a single blast, and immediately they were extinguished.

p.src: 36:30  Alas for the humans! No messenger ever comes to them but they ridicule him.

en: Alas for the humans! No messenger ever comes to them but they ridicule him.
ja: （復活の日*、懲罰を目の当たりにした時の、）僕たちの悲痛よ！使徒*が彼らのもとを訪れれば、彼らは決まって彼（使徒）のことを嘲笑したものだった。
u.src: 36:30  Alas for the humans! No messenger ever comes to them but they ridicule him.

p.src: 36:31  Do they not see how many generations We destroyed before them who will never come back to them[8]?

en: Do they not see how many generations We destroyed before them who will never come back to them[8]?
ja: 一体彼らは、われら*が彼ら以前にどれだけ多くの世代を滅ぼしたのかを、見なかったのか？彼らは、（現世にいる）彼らのもとに戻っては来ない。
u.src: 36:31  Do they not see how many generations We destroyed before them who will never come back to them[8]?

en: [8] i.e., to the life of this world.

p.src: 36:32  Yet all of them will be brought before Us.

en: Yet all of them will be brought before Us.
ja: そして（それら滅ぼされた世代の）全ての者は、（復活の日*には）例外なく、われら*のもとに（清算のため）連れて来られるのである。
u.src: 36:32  Yet all of them will be brought before Us.

p.src: 36:33  There is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life and produce from it grain for them to eat.

en: There is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life and produce from it grain for them to eat.
ja: また、死んだ土地は彼らへの御徴[1]である。われら*はそれを息吹かせ、そこから種粒を生育させ、あなた方はそこから食べるのだ。
u.src: 36:33  There is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life and produce from it grain for them to eat.

ja: [1]　この「御徴」は、アッラー*に復活と、再生を行う力があることの証拠（ムヤッサル４４2頁参照）。

p.src: 36:34  And We have made therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth,

en: And We have made therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth,
ja: また、われら*はそこに、ナツメヤシ、葡萄からなる果樹園を設け、そこに泉を噴出させたのである。
u.src: 36:34  And We have made therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth,

p.src: 36:35  so that they may eat of its fruit that was not made by their hands[9]. Will they not then give thanks?

en: so that they may eat of its fruit that was not made by their hands[9]. Will they not then give thanks?
ja: （それは）彼らが果実から食するためーーそれを作ったのは、彼らの手ではない[1]－－。彼らは、（この恩恵に）感謝しないのか？
u.src: 36:35  so that they may eat of its fruit that was not made by their hands[9]. Will they not then give thanks?

en: [9] i.e., that which Allah has produced for them without labor on their part.
ja: [1]　「彼らがその果実と、自分たちが作ったものを食べるため」という解釈もある（アッ＝タバリー８：６８３1－６８３2参照）。

p.src: 36:36  Glory be to the One Who created all types of things[10] that the earth produces, and of themselves, and of things that they have no knowledge about.

en: Glory be to the One Who created all types of things[10] that the earth produces, and of themselves, and of things that they have no knowledge about.
ja: 大地から生育するものの内に、あらゆる種類をお創りになったお方に称え*あれ。そしてあなた方自身[1]の内と、あなた方の知らないものの内にも。
u.src: 36:36  Glory be to the One Who created all types of things[10] that the earth produces, and of themselves, and of things that they have no knowledge about.

en: [10] i.e., all species, all things in pairs.
ja: [1]　つまり人間のことも性別、形質、外面的・内面的特徴において、異なるものとされた（アッ＝サァディー６９５頁参照）。

p.src: 36:37  There is another sign for them in the night: We strip from it the daylight, and they are left in darkness.

en: There is another sign for them in the night: We strip from it the daylight, and they are left in darkness.
ja: また、夜は彼らへの御徴[1]である。われら*がそこから昼を剥ぎ取ると、どうであろう、彼らは真っ暗になってしまう。
u.src: 36:37  There is another sign for them in the night: We strip from it the daylight, and they are left in darkness.

ja: [1]　この「御徴」は、アッラーの唯一性*と、完全なる御力を示す証拠のこと（ムヤッサル４４2頁参照）。

p.src: 36:38  The sun is running to its determined course. That is the design of the All-Mighty, All-Knowing.

en: The sun is running to its determined course. That is the design of the All-Mighty, All-Knowing.
ja: また、その停まり場[1]へと進み行く太陽も（、彼らへの御徴）。それは偉力ならびない*お方、全知者のお定めなのだ。
u.src: 36:38  The sun is running to its determined course. That is the design of the All-Mighty, All-Knowing.

ja: [1]　毎日、あるいは毎年の、決められた周期のこと。あるいは、その動きが止まる、この世の終わりのこと（アル＝カースィミー1４：５００５参照）。

p.src: 36:39  As for the moon, We have determined phases for it, until it becomes like an old palm stalk.

en: As for the moon, We have determined phases for it, until it becomes like an old palm stalk.
ja: また、月も。われら*はそれが（細い三日月から満月となり、再び）古い茎[1]のように戻り行くまで、（毎晩の）その諸々の宿り場を定めた。
u.src: 36:39  As for the moon, We have determined phases for it, until it becomes like an old palm stalk.

ja: [1]　この「茎（ウルジューン）」とは、ナツメヤシの実をつける、先端部分の茎のこと。その細さ、湾曲（わんきょく）した形、黄色い色ゆえに、細い三日月にたとえられている（ムヤッサル４４2頁参照）。

p.src: 36:40  It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor for the night to outstrip the day. Each is floating in its own orbit.

en: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor for the night to outstrip the day. Each is floating in its own orbit.
ja: 太陽が月に追いつくことはありえず、夜が昼に先駆けることもない。そして全ては、その軌道を走る。
u.src: 36:40  It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor for the night to outstrip the day. Each is floating in its own orbit.

p.src: 36:41  Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring[11] in the loaded Ark,

en: Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring[11] in the loaded Ark,
ja: また、われら*が彼ら（アーダム*の子ら）の子孫を、（各種の生き物で）満載された船[1]で運んだのも、（アッラー*のみが崇拝*されるべきことを示す、）彼らへの御徴である。
u.src: 36:41  Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring[11] in the loaded Ark,

en: [11] "Dhurriyyah" (lit., offspring); however, it is used here to denote ancestors (being the offspring of Noah) who were saved from the flood.
ja: [1]　これは預言者*ヌーフ*と信仰者たち、生き物たちを乗せた船のこと（前掲書４４３頁参照）。

p.src: 36:42  and We created for them similar things on which they ride.

en: and We created for them similar things on which they ride.
ja: またわれら*は彼ら[1]にも、彼らが乗る、それと同じような物を作った。
u.src: 36:42  and We created for them similar things on which they ride.

ja: [1]　「彼ら」とは、シルク*の徒や、その他の者たち（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 36:43  If We willed, We could drown them, then there would be no one to respond to their cry, nor could they be rescued,

en: If We willed, We could drown them, then there would be no one to respond to their cry, nor could they be rescued,
ja: もしわれら*が望めば、彼らを溺れさせるのである。そして彼らにはいかなる救助者もなく、救われることもない。
u.src: 36:43  If We willed, We could drown them, then there would be no one to respond to their cry, nor could they be rescued,

p.src: 36:44  except by a mercy from Us, leaving them to enjoy for a while.

en: except by a mercy from Us, leaving them to enjoy for a while.
ja: しかし、われら*からの慈悲ゆえ、そして（彼らに定められた）時[1]までの楽しみゆえ（、彼らを無事に運行させるのだ）。
u.src: 36:44  except by a mercy from Us, leaving them to enjoy for a while.

ja: [1]　この「時」は、死期、あるいは復活の日*のこととされる（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：３５参照）。

p.src: 36:45  When it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you and what is behind you[12], so that you may be shown mercy[13].”

en: When it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you and what is behind you[12], so that you may be shown mercy[13].”
ja: また、彼ら（シルク*の徒）に、「あなた方の前にあるものと、あなた方の後ろにあるもの[1]を畏れ*よ。（それは）あなた方が、（アッラー*）から慈しまれるようにするためなのだ」と言われれば（、彼らは背を向け、それに応じなかった）。
u.src: 36:45  When it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you and what is behind you[12], so that you may be shown mercy[13].”

en:
[12] Of what awaits you in this life and in the Hereafter, or of the sins of the past and the future.
 [13] But they ignored the warning.
ja: [1]　「前にあるもの」は来世と、彼らを待ち受ける恐怖のこと。「後ろにあるもの」とは、現世と、そこにおける懲罰のこと（ムヤッサル４４３頁参照）。

p.src: 36:46  No sign ever comes to them from their Lord except that they turn away from it.

en: No sign ever comes to them from their Lord except that they turn away from it.
ja: そして彼らの主*の御徴[1]の内、いかなる御徴が彼らのもとに到来した時でも、彼らがそれに背を向けないことはなかったのである。
u.src: 36:46  No sign ever comes to them from their Lord except that they turn away from it.

ja: [1]　この「御徴」とは、アッラーの唯一性*と預言者*ムハンマド*の正直さを示す根拠の数々のこと（イブン・カスィール６：５８０参照）。

p.src: 36:47  And when it is said to them, “Spend of what Allah has provided you with”, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Should we feed those whom Allah could feed if He willed? You are clearly misguided!”

en: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what Allah has provided you with”, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Should we feed those whom Allah could feed if He willed? You are clearly misguided!”
ja: また彼らに、「アッラー*があなた方に授けたものから、（施しのために）費やす[1]のだ」と言われれば、不信仰に陥った者*たちは信仰する者たちに、（こう）言った。「もしアッラー*がお望みになれば食べさせ給うた者に、私たちが食べさせるというのか？[2]あなた方は確かに、紛れもない迷いの中にいる[3]」。
u.src: 36:47  And when it is said to them, “Spend of what Allah has provided you with”, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Should we feed those whom Allah could feed if He willed? You are clearly misguided!”

ja: [1]　雌牛章３の訳注も参照。 [2]　ムスリム*たちは恵まれない者への施しを勧めていたが、彼らは吝嗇と嘲笑ゆえに、「アッラー*が食を禁じられた者に、私たちが食べさせるわけにはいかない」「全ての物事はアッラー*の御手に委ねられているなら、どうして私たちに施しを求めるのか？」などと返した（イブン・ジュザイ2：22５参照）。 [3]　「あなた方は確かに・・・」という言葉は、不信仰者*たちに対するアッラー*の言葉、あるいは不信仰者*たちに対する信仰者たちの言葉、という説もある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：３７参照）。

p.src: 36:48  They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”

en: They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
ja: 彼ら（不信仰者*）は、言う。「（復活の）この約束はいつなのか？もしあなた方が本当のことを言っているのなら」。
u.src: 36:48  They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”

p.src: 36:49  They are not awaiting but a single Blast that will seize them while they are still disputing[14].

en: They are not awaiting but a single Blast that will seize them while they are still disputing[14].
ja: 彼らは、彼らが（現世の生活において）議論し合っている最中に自分たちを（突然）襲う、（轟きの）一声[1]を待っているに過ぎない。
u.src: 36:49  They are not awaiting but a single Blast that will seize them while they are still disputing[14].

en: [14] The first blast (lit., a cry or a shriek) of the Trumpet will take them by surprise on the Day of Judgment while they will be disputing in their worldly affairs.
ja: [1]　復活の日*に吹き鳴らされる、最初の角笛の一吹きのこと（ムヤッサル４４３頁参照）。家畜章７３の訳注も参照。

p.src: 36:50  Then they will not be able to make a will, nor will they be able to return to their households.

en: Then they will not be able to make a will, nor will they be able to return to their households.
ja: そして彼らは（その時、誰にも）遺言できないし、家族のもとに戻ることも出来ない。[1]
u.src: 36:50  Then they will not be able to make a will, nor will they be able to return to their households.

ja: [1]　つまり、その場で即死するということ（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 36:51  The Trumpet will be blown[15] [again], and at once they will rush from their graves to their Lord.

en: The Trumpet will be blown[15] [again], and at once they will rush from their graves to their Lord.
ja: そして（二度目に）角笛に吹き込まれると[1]、どうであろう、彼らは墓から（出て来て、）自分たちの主*の御許へと、急いで馳せ参じて行く。
u.src: 36:51  The Trumpet will be blown[15] [again], and at once they will rush from their graves to their Lord.

en: [15] i.e., the second blast or blow.
ja: [1]　二度目の角笛が鳴らされると、魂は肉体に戻らされて復活する（ムヤッサル４４３頁参照）。

p.src: 36:52  They will say, “Woe to us! Who has resurrected us from our resting place?” [They will be told,] “This is what the Most Compassionate promised, and the messengers told the truth.”

en: They will say, “Woe to us! Who has resurrected us from our resting place?” [They will be told,] “This is what the Most Compassionate promised, and the messengers told the truth.”
ja: 彼らは（無念がって、こう）言うのだ、「我らが災いよ！[1]私たちを、私たちの寝床から蘇らせたのは誰だ？」（すると、彼らにこう言われる。）「これが、慈悲あまねき*お方（アッラー*）が約束され給い、使徒*たちが正直に語ったものである」。
u.src: 36:52  They will say, “Woe to us! Who has resurrected us from our resting place?” [They will be told,] “This is what the Most Compassionate promised, and the messengers told the truth.”

ja: [1]　この表現については、食卓章３1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 36:53  It will only be a single Blast, and at once they will all be brought before Us.

en: It will only be a single Blast, and at once they will all be brought before Us.
ja: （復活は、轟きの）一声に過ぎなかったのだ。そしてどうであろう、彼らは皆、（清算と報いのため）われら*のもとに連れて来られるのである。
u.src: 36:53  It will only be a single Blast, and at once they will all be brought before Us.

p.src: 36:54  On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be recompensed except for what you used to do.

en: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be recompensed except for what you used to do.
ja: この日、人は少しも不正*を受けることがない。そしてあなた方が報われるのは、自分たちが（現世で）行っていたこと（によるもの）以外の、何ものでもない。
u.src: 36:54  On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be recompensed except for what you used to do.

p.src: 36:55  Indeed, on that Day the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves,

en: Indeed, on that Day the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves,
ja: 実に天国の住人たちはその日、（様々な安寧に）喜々として忙しい。
u.src: 36:55  Indeed, on that Day the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves,

p.src: 36:56  they and their spouses will be reclining on couches in the shade.

en: they and their spouses will be reclining on couches in the shade.
ja: 彼らとその妻たちは日陰におり、寝台に寄りかかっている。
u.src: 36:56  they and their spouses will be reclining on couches in the shade.

p.src: 36:57  They will have therein fruits and all what they ask for[16].

en: They will have therein fruits and all what they ask for[16].
ja: 彼らはそこで（様々な）果実があり、彼らには自分たちが求める（あらゆる）ものがある。
u.src: 36:57  They will have therein fruits and all what they ask for[16].

en: [16] i.e., wish or desire.

p.src: 36:58  “Peace”: a word from a Most Merciful Lord.

en: “Peace”: a word from a Most Merciful Lord.
ja: 慈愛深き*主（アッラー*）からのお言葉、「（あなた方に）平安あれ」（という挨拶も。）[1]
u.src: 36:58  “Peace”: a word from a Most Merciful Lord.

ja: [1]　「平安を」については、雷鳴章2４の訳注を参照。（前掲書４４４頁参照）。

p.src: 36:59  “Stand apart [from the believers] this Day, O wicked ones!

en: “Stand apart [from the believers] this Day, O wicked ones!
ja: そして（不信仰者*たちには、こう言われる。）「この日、あなた方は（信仰者たちから）離れていよ。罪悪者たちめ」。[1]
u.src: 36:59  “Stand apart [from the believers] this Day, O wicked ones!

ja: [1]　ユーヌス*章2８とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 36:60  Did I not command you, O children of Adam, not to worship Satan, for he is your sworn enemy,

en: Did I not command you, O children of Adam, not to worship Satan, for he is your sworn enemy,
ja: （アッラー*は彼らに仰せられる。）アーダム*の子らよ、一体われは、（使徒*たちを通じて）あなた方に命じなかったのか？シャイターン*を崇める[1]のではない、と？本当に彼は、あなた方にとって紛れもない敵なのだから。
u.src: 36:60  Did I not command you, O children of Adam, not to worship Satan, for he is your sworn enemy,

ja: [1]　「シャイターン*を崇める」とは、彼への服従のこと。そこには、あらゆる種類の不信仰と罪が含まれる（アッ＝サァディー６９８頁参照）。

p.src: 36:61  but to worship Me? This is a straight path.

en: but to worship Me? This is a straight path.
ja: また、われ（のみ）を崇拝*せよ、と（命じなかったのか）？これが（わが喜びと天国へと至る、）まっすぐな道なのである。
u.src: 36:61  but to worship Me? This is a straight path.

p.src: 36:62  He had already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not then have sense?

en: He had already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not then have sense?
ja: また、彼（シャイターン*）はあなた方の内、多くの創造物を迷わせた[1]。一体、あなた方は弁えていなかったのか？
u.src: 36:62  He had already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not then have sense?

ja: [1]　シャイターン*が人類を迷わせることとなった経緯（いきさつ）については、高壁章11－1８、アル＝ヒジュル章2８－４2、夜の旅章６1－６５、サード章７1－８５を参照。

p.src: 36:63  This is the Hell that you were promised.

en: This is the Hell that you were promised.
ja: これが、あなた方が（現世で）約束されていた地獄である。
u.src: 36:63  This is the Hell that you were promised.

p.src: 36:64  Burn in it Today for your disbelief[17].”

en: Burn in it Today for your disbelief[17].”
ja: あなた方は今日、自分たちが不信仰であったことゆえに、そこに入って炙られよ。
u.src: 36:64  Burn in it Today for your disbelief[17].”

en: [17] i.e., because you used to disbelieve.

p.src: 36:65  Today We will seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to all what they used to do.

en: Today We will seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to all what they used to do.
ja: 今日われら*は、彼ら（シルク*の徒）の口を封じる。そして彼らが稼いでいたもの（罪）については、彼らの手がわれらに話し、その足が証言するのである。[1]
u.src: 36:65  Today We will seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to all what they used to do.

ja: [1]　食卓章1０９、高壁章８、夜の旅章９７の各訳注、および御光章2４も参照。

p.src: 36:66  If We willed, We could have taken away their sight, so they would rush to find their way, but then how could they see?

en: If We willed, We could have taken away their sight, so they would rush to find their way, but then how could they see?
ja: また、もしわれら*が望めば、彼らの眼を消すことも出来るのだ。そうなれば彼らは道を競い合うが、どうして彼らが（道を）見ることが出来るだろうか？[1]
u.src: 36:66  If We willed, We could have taken away their sight, so they would rush to find their way, but then how could they see?

ja: [1]　このアーヤ*の意味には、「視力がなくなることのたとえ」「信仰における迷いのたとえ」「復活の日*、地獄の上にかけられた橋の話。そこを超えられる者は、天国の民しかない」といった解釈がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：４９－５０参照）。

p.src: 36:67  And if We willed, We could have paralyzed them in their places[18], so they could neither move forward nor backward.

en: And if We willed, We could have paralyzed them in their places[18], so they could neither move forward nor backward.
ja: また、もしわれら*が望めば、彼ら（の創造）をその場で変異させてしまうことも出来る。そうなれば彼らは進むことも出来なければ、戻れもしない。[1]
u.src: 36:67  And if We willed, We could have paralyzed them in their places[18], so they could neither move forward nor backward.

en: [18] i.e., We could turn them into inanimate objects.
ja: [1]　このアーヤ*の意味には、「石などの物質や、動物などに変異させ、思うように動けなくさせる」「復活の日*のこと（アーヤ*６６の訳注を参照）」といった解釈がある（前掲書1５：５０参照）。

p.src: 36:68  Whomsoever We give a long life, We cause his strength to decline[19]. Do they not then understand?

en: Whomsoever We give a long life, We cause his strength to decline[19]. Do they not then understand?
ja: また、われら*が長生きさせる者があれば、われら*はその創造を逆転させる[1]。一体、彼らは弁えないのか？
u.src: 36:68  Whomsoever We give a long life, We cause his strength to decline[19]. Do they not then understand?

en: [19] Humans are born weak, then they reach their prime when they are young, then they grow physically and mentally weak when they are old.
ja: [1]　高齢になると、幼少期のように、知的・身体的に弱体化することを表す（ムヤッサル４４４頁参照）。

p.src: 36:69  We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This is only a Reminder and a clear Qur’an

en: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This is only a Reminder and a clear Qur’an
ja: われら*は彼（預言者*ムハンマド*）に詩を教えたりはしなかったし、それは彼に相応しくないこと。それは教訓と、解明する[1]クルアーン*に外ならないのだ。
u.src: 36:69  We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This is only a Reminder and a clear Qur’an

ja: [1]　「解明する」については、ユースフ*章1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 36:70  so that he may warn those who are truly alive[20] and establish the argument against the disbelievers.

en: so that he may warn those who are truly alive[20] and establish the argument against the disbelievers.
ja: （それは）彼が（心の）生きている者[1]に警告し、不信仰者*たちに御言葉が確定する[2]ためのものなのである。
u.src: 36:70  so that he may warn those who are truly alive[20] and establish the argument against the disbelievers.

en: [20] In heart and mind, i.e., those who have faith.
ja: [1]　心が生き、目覚めている者こそが、クルアーン*によって清められ、その知識と行いを深める者である。それはちょうど、良質の土地に雨が降る様子に似ている（アッ＝サァディー６９８頁参照）。高壁章５８とその訳注も参照。 [2]　この「御言葉」は、懲罰のこと。クルアーン*という明白な根拠ゆえ、彼らは自分たちが不信仰であったことに関し、言い逃れできなくなる（ムヤッサル４４４頁参照）。

p.src: 36:71  Do they not see that We have created for them livestock made by Our Hands, and then they are their owners?

en: Do they not see that We have created for them livestock made by Our Hands, and then they are their owners?
ja: そして彼らは、われら*が彼らのために、われら*の手がなしたものである家畜を創造したのを見なかったのか？彼らはそれらの所有者なのである。
u.src: 36:71  Do they not see that We have created for them livestock made by Our Hands, and then they are their owners?

p.src: 36:72  And We have made them subservient to them; some they ride, and from others they eat,

en: And We have made them subservient to them; some they ride, and from others they eat,
ja: そしてわれら*は、それら（家畜）を彼らのために仕えさせた。その内には彼らの乗り物があり、また彼らはそこから食べるのである。
u.src: 36:72  And We have made them subservient to them; some they ride, and from others they eat,

p.src: 36:73  and there are other benefits and drinks therein for them. Will they not then give thanks?

en: and there are other benefits and drinks therein for them. Will they not then give thanks?
ja: また、そこ（家畜）には彼らにとっての（別の）利益[1]と飲み物[2]もある。一体、彼らは感謝し（て、アッラー*のみを崇拝*し）ないのか？
u.src: 36:73  and there are other benefits and drinks therein for them. Will they not then give thanks?

ja: [1]　具体的な利益の例については、蜜蜂章５－８、８０も参照。 [2]　つまり、乳のこと（ムヤッサル４４５頁参照）。蜜蜂章６６も参照。

p.src: 36:74  Yet they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping that they may be helped.

en: Yet they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping that they may be helped.
ja: 彼ら（シルク*の徒）は、アッラー*をよそに（崇める）神々[1]を選んだ。自分たちが（それらによって、アッラー*の懲罰から）助けられるように、と。
u.src: 36:74  Yet they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping that they may be helped.

ja: [1]　「神々」に関しては、雌牛章1３３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 36:75  They cannot help them, yet they serve them as their dedicated guards[21].

en: They cannot help them, yet they serve them as their dedicated guards[21].
ja: 彼ら（それらの神々）は、彼ら（その崇拝者たち）を助けることなど出来ない。彼らは彼らのために、立ち会わされた兵隊であるというのに[1]。
u.src: 36:75  They cannot help them, yet they serve them as their dedicated guards[21].

en: [21] Or their idols or so-called gods will be assembled to witness the punishment of their worshipers on the Day of Judgment.
ja: [1]　この二つの「彼ら」は、前者がシルク*の徒、後者がその神々という説と、その逆という説がある。前者の説の場合、現世において、シルク*の徒がそれらの神々の兵隊的な存在であることを、後者の説の場合、それらの神々が彼らと共に地獄に入ることを意味する（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：５７参照）。

p.src: 36:76  Do not let their words grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

en: Do not let their words grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
ja: ならば（使徒*よ）、彼らの言葉[1]に悲しんではならない。実にわれら*は彼らが秘密にしていることも、露わにしていることも知っているのだから。
u.src: 36:76  Do not let their words grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

ja: [1]　アッラー*への不信仰、使徒*の噓つき呼ばわり、彼への嘲笑などに関する言葉（ムヤッサル４４５頁参照）。

p.src: 36:77  Does man not see that We have created him from a sperm-drop, then[22] he becomes a clear adversary,

en: Does man not see that We have created him from a sperm-drop, then[22] he becomes a clear adversary,
ja: 一体、（復活を否定する）人間は、われら*が彼を一滴の精液から創った[1]のを見なかったのか？なのにどうであろうか、彼はあからさまな反論者である[2]。
u.src: 36:77  Does man not see that We have created him from a sperm-drop, then[22] he becomes a clear adversary,

en: [22] i.e., as soon as he becomes a self-sufficient being.
ja: [1]　人間の創造の変遷については、巡礼*章５、信仰者たち章1４とその訳注を参照。 [2]　蜜蜂章４の訳注も参照。

p.src: 36:78  producing arguments[23] against Us while forgetting his own creation[24]. He says, “Who can give life to the bones after they have crumbled to dust?”

en: producing arguments[23] against Us while forgetting his own creation[24]. He says, “Who can give life to the bones after they have crumbled to dust?”
ja: そして彼は自分自身の創造を忘れて、われら*に対して（許されない）譬え[1]を挙げた。彼は言ったのだ。「誰が、朽ち果てた骨に生を与えるというのか？」
u.src: 36:78  producing arguments[23] against Us while forgetting his own creation[24]. He says, “Who can give life to the bones after they have crumbled to dust?”

en:
[23] Trying to prove that there is no life after death.
 [24] That we created him from dead matter to such an extent that he became now a clear disputant before Us.
ja: [1]　創造主の力を、創造物の力と同様のものとして推測したことを表す（ムヤッサル４４５頁参照）。

p.src: 36:79  Say, “The One Who created them in the first place will give life to them, for He has full knowledge of every created being;

en: Say, “The One Who created them in the first place will give life to them, for He has full knowledge of every created being;
ja: 言ってやれ。「それを最初にお創りになったお方が、それに生を与えられる。かれは、全ての創造についてご存知のお方」。
u.src: 36:79  Say, “The One Who created them in the first place will give life to them, for He has full knowledge of every created being;

p.src: 36:80  the One Who made for you fire out of the green tree, with which you kindle your fires[25].”

en: the One Who made for you fire out of the green tree, with which you kindle your fires[25].”
ja: （かれは）あなた方のために（湿った）緑樹から、火を生じさせられるお方[1]。そしてどうであろう、あなた方はそこから火を起こすのである。
u.src: 36:80  the One Who made for you fire out of the green tree, with which you kindle your fires[25].”

en: [25] It alludes to the "markh" and "‘afār" trees in Arabia, whose green branches if struck against each other, it produces sparks.
ja: [1]　つまり、ある物から全く反対の物を創造することが可能なお方は、死人に生を与え、蘇（よみがえ）らせることも可能である（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 36:81  Is not the One Who created the heavens and earth able to create the like of these [people]? Yes indeed, for He is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.

en: Is not the One Who created the heavens and earth able to create the like of these [people]? Yes indeed, for He is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.
ja: 一体、諸天と大地をお創りになったお方は、彼らと同様のものを（再び）お創りになることが出来るお方ではないか？いや、（かれにはお出来である、）そしてかれは創造主、全知者であられるのだ。
u.src: 36:81  Is not the One Who created the heavens and earth able to create the like of these [people]? Yes indeed, for He is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.

p.src: 36:82  Whenever He wills something to be, He only says to it, “Be”, and it is.

en: Whenever He wills something to be, He only says to it, “Be”, and it is.
ja: 本当にかれのご命令というものは、かれが一事をお望みになった時、それに「あれ」と仰せられるだけで、それは存在するのである。
u.src: 36:82  Whenever He wills something to be, He only says to it, “Be”, and it is.

p.src: 36:83  So glory be to the One in Whose Hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will all be returned.

en: So glory be to the One in Whose Hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will all be returned.
ja: ならば、称え*あれ。その御手にこそ、全てのことの絶対なる王権が属するお方に。そしてかれの御許にこそ、あなた方は戻らされるのである。
u.src: 36:83  So glory be to the One in Whose Hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will all be returned.
